gaps.lead: He couldn't swim until he was twenty.
gaps.sentence: He ___ swim until he was twenty.
gaps.explanation: was unable to = couldn't (general ability in the past).

gaps.lead: 'I broke the window,' said the boy.
gaps.explanation: admit + -ing (optionally 'to'): admitted breaking / admitted to breaking.

gaps.lead: The train takes two hours to get there; the plane takes thirty minutes.
gaps.explanation: twice as fast as = half the time of.

gaps.lead: She got up early so that she wouldn't miss the train.
gaps.sentence: She got up early ___ the train.
gaps.explanation: so as not to / in order not to + infinitive express negative purpose.

gaps.lead: Nobody in the class is as tall as Petra.
gaps.explanation: X is taller than everyone = X is the tallest (person).
suggest + -ing (or suggest that + clause): suggested having.
